excerpt.zh: 近期[stealing_fleet.GetName]参观[stolen_from_planet.GetName]之后，人们发现有一部分资源居然莫名其妙消失了。人们怀疑是被[stealing_fleet.GetName]给顺手牵羊了。
excerpt.en: After a recent visit of the [stealing_fleet.GetName] to [stolen_from_planet.GetName] it has been noticed that a number of resources are missing from the central reserve. It is suspected that the [stealing_fleet.GetName] somehow made off with them.
